title: List the top 5 leagues in ascending order of the number of goals made in al
question:
List the top 5 leagues in ascending order of the number of goals made in all seasons combined.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: number of goals made in all seasons combine = SUM(home_team_goal, away_team_goal);

prediction.sql:
SELECT L.XCL_005 AS league
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_008
GROUP BY L.XCL_003, L.XCL_005
ORDER BY SUM(M.XCL_015 + M.XCL_016) ASC
LIMIT 5;
